assertion.statement: For the actual elliptic curve E/Q, the Cassels–Tate pairing induces a nondegenerate alternating pairing on the quotient of Sha(E) by its maximal divisible subgroup, hence on its finite2-primary quotient F in the supplied decomposition.
assertion.objects: The canonical principal polarization on E, Sha(E), its maximal divisible subgroup, and F=Sha(E)[2∞]/Sha(E)[2∞]_div.
assertion.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over Q. The supplied finite-Selmer/cofinite-generation input gives Sha(E)[2∞]=(Q2/Z2)^t⊕F with F finite. No finiteness of the full Sha group is assumed.
assertion.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve E/Q; the finite-quotient application holds for its actual2-primary decomposition.
assertion.parameter_range: Canonical genus-one principal polarization;2-primary quotient by maximal divisibility, not the unrestricted pairing on2-torsion.
assertion.uniformity: No quantitative bound or uniform finiteness statement.
assertion.constants: The quotient has paired finite primary cyclic factors; in particular dim_F2 F[2] is even.
assertion.normalizations: Cor4 gives c via Pic^(g−1); at g=1 the trivial degree-zero class makes c=0. Cor7 gives alternation. Nondegeneracy is after maximal-divisible quotient. Different primary torsion components are orthogonal.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not equate infinitely divisible elements with the maximal divisible subgroup in an arbitrary group. Current decomposition proves maximality directly. Do not infer nondegeneracy of the restriction to F[2], or finiteSha, or Mordell–Weil rank1 before RC.
assertion.limit_order: First use the separately supplied decomposition and identify its maximal divisible subgroup. Then restrict the quotient pairing to the finite2-primary part and apply the paired-factor argument; only afterward combine with Kummer dimensions.

assertion.statement: For an elliptic curve overQ with full rational2-torsion, two-Selmer dimension3 implies full2-infinity Selmer corank1 without assuming finite Sha.
assertion.objects: The finite Kummer sequence, rankr, cofinitely generated Sha[2-infinity]=(Q2/Z2)^t plus finite F and its canonical principal-polarization pairing.
assertion.hypotheses: Full rational2-torsion and dimF2 Sel2=3; finite-generation/Kummer structure and the alternating nondegenerate Cassels–Tate pairing on the finite quotient by the maximal divisible subgroup are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve overQ meeting these hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Full2-primary Selmer corank, not Mordell–Weil rank alone.
assertion.uniformity: No quantitative bound or uniform finiteness assumption.
assertion.constants: r+dim Sha[2]=1; dimF[2] is even; hence F=0 and r+t=1.
assertion.normalizations: The divisible subgroup is the actual maximal divisible subgroup because every divisible subgroup maps trivially to finiteF. Pair finite primary cyclic factors, not the restricted pairing onF[2].
assertion.exceptional_cases: Sha may have a nonzero divisible part. The pairing onF[2] need not be nondegenerate and is not used. Pairing source validation remains separate.
assertion.limit_order: Apply finite Kummer dimensions; decompose the cofinitely generated2-primary group; use alternation on its finite quotient to forceF=0; apply the full Kummer sequence for corank.

assertion.statement: Every elliptic curve A/Q of arithmetic conductor N is modular and admits a finite surjective Q-morphism X0(N) to A.
assertion.objects: The actual elliptic curve A/Q, its arithmetic conductor N and its conductor-level modular parametrization.
assertion.hypotheses: A is an elliptic curve over Q.
assertion.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve over Q; no semistability, residual-image or non-CM restriction.
assertion.parameter_range: Arithmetic conductor N of the same A, not an arbitrary enlarged level.
assertion.uniformity: Qualitative existence for each A; no effective degree bound.
assertion.normalizations: Published Silverman second edition C.13.6 and C.16.4(a),(c); BCDT attribution retained.
assertion.exceptional_cases: C.16.4(b) Fricke formula excluded. No normalized newform, optimality, Manin constant or Hecke identity inferred.
assertion.limit_order: Choose A and its conductor, then its parametrization before forming later quotient maps.
